game.name: A Doukutsu Demake
game.desc: Demake of Cave Story

game.name: A Hat on Time
game.desc: The Conductor's train went off the rails near the desolate plains of Ash Town, so Hat Kid has returned to the planet to make sure her friends are okay, and to find a mysterious relic! Grab all 30 time pieces in this short platformer, based on the game A Hat in Time!

game.name: A Messengers Tale
game.desc: The Royal Messenger is asked to deliver a very important letter to the East Kingdom, and stumbles across a rare and powerful artifact.

game.name: A Very Warm Fire
game.desc: Keep the fire burning, stay warm, and don't get lost. How long can you survive against the wilds?

game.name: Across The River
game.desc: Can you bring the wolf, the goat, the cabbage, the hunter, the gun, the monkey and the washing machine on the other side !?

game.name: Aeroplane Adventure
game.desc: Piloto, tu hermano es un explorador polar. ¡Se metió en problemas! ¡Solo llévalo a casa!

game.name: Alex Kidd in Pico World
game.desc: Después de Miracle, Techno y Shinobi, Alex encontró otro mundo en el que aventurarse, ¡y no fue fácil! ¡Encerrarse en un mundo que sólo existe dentro de un límite de 8192 tokens no es tarea fácil! ¡Pero eso no es problema para el malvado puño de Alex!

game.name: Alien Fish Invasion
game.desc: An old-fashioned arcade shooter, like Defender but not as difficult to play. The end result differs quite a bit from Defender - except for its difficulty level. ;) Tip 1: Completely wipe out a cluster of aliens and you'll earn an extra life. Survival means earning lives faster than you lose them (and you will lose them very fast). Tip 2: If you already have three lives, an extra life will power up your smartbomb meter instead. When it's full - BOOM! Humanity's future depends on you triggering as many smartbombs as you can. Tip 3: Those speedy pink loner aliens? Hunt them down! They're the last of their cluster, so that's where your extra lives/smartbombs come from.

game.name: Alien Harvest
game.desc: Dylan Burke is finishing the job his father failed to complete on LV-426. He must be stopped. Explore planets and collect 12 alien eggs before Burke can get to them.

game.name: Alpine Alpaca
game.desc: Corre cuesta abajo y pasa a través de tantas puertas como puedas. Usa tus cartas para guiar y construir tu mazo a medida que avanzas!

game.name: Alpine Ascent
game.desc: A casual climbing platformer. When your stamina bar runs out, you can't jump or cling to walls. You can replenish stamina by landing on the ground, or spending a green coin. Gold coins will increase your max stamina.

game.name: Amazeball Dudes
game.desc: 1-2 player beat em up based on the Nes version of Bad Dudes with a bit of Mighty Final Fight mixed in.

game.name: Anteform
game.desc: Steve Johanson has disappeared and his girlfriend Sally Franklin has hired your detective agency to locate him. Even before you get on the scene there are signs that maybe this isn't just a simple missing persons case. Can you crack it? Explore Anteform Valley and its settlements, talk to its residents, search desks and files, and build up your skills as you collect clues to figure out what really happened to Steve and maybe even prevent it from happening again. This is a sci-fi / horror detective story RPG in the style of the old-school 8-bit Ultima games as they were found on the C128.

game.name: Astro Invader
game.desc: Demake of an arcade invaders shoot'em up.

game.name: Bald Boi Dungeon Of The Slimes
Basement
game.desc: "Basement" is an exploration-based platformer in which the main threat is fall damage and the main challenge is finding safe paths through each section. I consider the quotation marks as part of the title. The game takes place in the caverns underneath a magical castle and includes several interconnected areas which can be explored in various orders. In addition, there are extra things to find that result in bonus dialogue. I tried to design the game in such a way as to not need to explain how anything works. In addition, the difficulty curve is based on the idea of harder sections being harder to find. The ways to get to areas other than the first one all require some trick that the player can learn in a different area, thus forming a progression that is intended to be similar to a metroidvania, but with the upgrades occurring in the player rather than the player character. I would estimate about an hour to finish, with the minimum playtime being as low as 10 minutes. Just in case, though, there is a save system.

game.name: Bear Arms The Revenge of the Wild Gunner
Bicycle Race - a Pico-8 Chinese Bootleg
game.desc: Bicycle Race (un juego pirata chino de Pico-8) es un juego de carreras donde manejas una moto. Adelanta a tus oponentes y completa la carrera en el tiempo limite. Los controles son simples (acelerar, derecha e izquierda), conforme progreses más puntos vas a obtener.

game.name: Block Rush
game.desc: Block Rush is a retro styled puzzle game where you can't stop moving until you hit something. Reach the chest to win and take the crown for added challenge. Encounter a variety of objects as you progress through the increasingly difficult levels. Get to the kings crown and reach the chest afterwards.

game.name: Bombers Run
game.desc: Take on the role of Bomber, a magical curious creature who in ready for a new adventure. Jump, dodge, stomp and bomb your way through this intense retro arcade game.

game.name: Boulder Run
game.desc: This game is a Pico-8 remake of the Commodore 64 game Boulder Dash. It features all of the classic caves and levels, plus a handful of puzzle levels thrown in for good measure.

game.name: Brutal Pico Race
game.desc: Brutal Pico Race is a fast and raw futurist racing game. Choose one ship out of three class, choose a track and try to finish first ! You can also challenge a friend, alone or with AI, in split-screen mode !

game.name: Byte Sabor - Endless arcade action combined with roguelite
Cake Monsters
game.desc: Move the monsters with the arrow keys. They only eat cake that is the same color as they are. You clear a level when there is no cake left. You can undo movements or reset a whole level. There are 36 levels.

game.name: Captain Neat-O in the Time Nexus
game.desc: Time is all of a jumble and Captain Neat-O is trapped in the middle of it! Battle enemies, solve puzzles and find the tools you need to escape the Time Nexus and stop whoever is behind this nefarious plot. Gain an extra heart for every 100 gems collected. There are 300 gems to collect in total but some of them are hidden in secrets areas so keep an eye out for walls look a little bit different. This is an entry for Toy Box Jam 3 using the graphics, music and sound effect assets supplied as part of the jam.

game.name: Celeste Classic 2
game.desc: A PICO-8 platformer about hiking around a mountain, made in three days for Celeste's third anniversary.

game.name: Charge!
game.desc: A Viking rampage! Trample over commoners and shield yourself from the arrows of your enemies.

game.name: Chicken Cutter Turbo
game.desc: The definitive version of Chicken Cutter. I'm going to leave this alone for now, as the features I want to add would require a complete revamp of the code I'm just not ready to tackle yet.

game.name: Spin-off Colony on a tiny planet
Curse of Kildren
game.desc: A Zelda like adventure. Defeat the wizard Kildren and release the kingdom from his wintery curse. Features an Overworld and 6 dungeons to explore. Includes 6 bosses, and many different enemies, weapons and items.

game.name: Curse of the Lich King
game.desc: The evil Lich King, Raq'zul, has cast a life draining spell on the world - in hopes to become immortal. Many heroes try to find him deep in his lair, but all have fallen to his army of monsters and devious traps. Now it is your turn! Curse of the Lich King gives you tactical grid based combat in a roguelike dungeon crawling setting. A cast of monsters will try to stop you, all in their own way as you descend towards the Lich King's crypt. Loot everything you see to make sure you find food and weapons to help you on your journey. But beware, not everything is what it seems... Are you ready to solve the tricky battles and master the Lich King's lair? Can you save the world? Good luck!
game.genre: Juego de Rol / RPG de Acción

game.name: Cyclo 8
game.desc: It's a "physic" bike game, a bit like the "Trials" series. 7 levels of increasing difficulty 15 collectibles per levels Time clock for speedruns

game.name: DanceJab
game.desc: This fighting game has only one attack - JAB! Shuffle and dash till the timing is right to - JAB! Or footsie to bait your opponent then - JAB! Hold centre stage. Don't fall off. Dance. JAB! Inspired by Super Smash Bros. and Divekick.

game.name: DeFacto
game.desc: DeFacto is a game about building a large automated factory chain. You must install miners to collect raw resources, transform them in furnaces, and combine them in factories. The final goal is to send rockets full of robots and by doing so continue to explore the galaxy. DeFacto is heavily inspired by the game Factorio.

game.name: Desert Drift
game.desc: An Outrun-esque racer.

game.name: Desert Lead 3D
game.desc: Take aim, fire and score! It's Desert Lead 3D! Spread the desert with the dented and shattered remains of bottles and cans. It's like recycling, but more destructive.

game.name: Disc Relay
game.desc: Time your speed and angle in an attempt to throw a Frisbee as far as possible. Then take control of the receiving player, and position yourself for the catch! If you do manage to catch it, quickly throw it again. Keep going until the Frisbee hits the ground, and see how far you can make it!

game.name: DodGet
game.desc: Here is DodGet, a more refined version of my previous project, DodGet Jr! It has some new features: -Normalized 8 direction movement (finally), both for the player and the fireballs. -The fireballs' starting direction when spawned is towards the player's position (use this strategically!). -The coins needed to perform the attack now increase by 1 instead of 5 after every attack. -A new 2D background. -A death animation, so that you don't instantly get the Game Over screen (which now also contains a phrase depending on your score!). -A more refined adaptive music system. -A local high score! -Three unlockable medals. -Two songs to choose from. -Some more fixes and general polish.

game.name: Dont Shit Your Pants PICO-8 Edition
game.desc: Don't Shit Your Pants puts you the pants of a poor sap who is desperately trying to heed Nature's call. Based on the text-based adventure games of old, the only tools at your 'disposal' are the limited text commands you can give the character on-screen. With 10 achievements to unlock, DSYP redefines the idea of survival horror. Will minstrels yarn tales of your bowel mastery for generations, or will you experience a mud-butt disaster of epic proportions?

game.name: Dragondell
game.desc: Dragondell is a cute and colourful adventure game. Collect loot by opening chests with keys. Befriend the royals, then take them back to the castle in the right colour (match the robes to the flags and lead them to the gate) Don't get spotted by the knights, you can spit fire at them by holding X (x), but it takes a few seconds. Once all the royals have returned, use the portal to end the game

game.name: Drogue
game.desc: Drogue (from "Dale's Rogue") is kind of an homage to old-school text-based rogue-likes. The main influences when working on it were LazyDev's amazing Porklike tutorial and one of my all time favorite games, Dungeon Craw Stone Soup. It features procedural generation of interconnected levels, monsters and treasure. The ultimate goal is a McGuffin in the rogue-like tradition: the mysterious Orb of Elad.

game.name: Dungeo - a Bards Tale-like game in PICO-8
game.desc: “Dungeo” tells the story of four heroes who face the Lich Queen to save the land from her threat. The town features locations such as the blacksmith for equipment upgrades, the inn for regeneration, the temple for curing status ailments, and the tavern for saving progress and enhancing skills. In the dungeon, the heroes gather experience, improve their attributes, and prepare for the ultimate battle against the powerful Lich Queen.
game.genre: Juego de Rol / RPG por Equipos

game.name: DUNGEON!
game.desc: DUNGEON! is a retro-styled video game where a different course of levels is randomly generated with every new attempt. See how far you can get by platforming and defeating monsters! You play as the knight Sir Charles, as he navigates through a treacherous dungeon in order to save a princess!

game.name: E10 - Death Road
game.desc: Will you manage to drive the road Lulea - Kiruna? Test yourself in this driving simulator! In addition, you also have a primed bomb on board, don't drive slower than 80 km/h! Stay on the road and avoid the trucks!

game.name: Eleni Foot Bag
game.desc: Inspired by California Games, improve your footbag skills with Eleni. Use your foot, heel, knee or head to gain a maximal score.

game.name: Endless Train
game.desc: Have you ever felt like you don't have enough trains in your life? Have you ever thought : "Man, I'd really go for a never-ending train ride right now" Well look no further because endless train is here!

game.name: Ennuigi
game.desc: Spend some time with a depressed, laconic Luigi as he chain smokes and wanders through a crumbling Mushroom Kingdom, ruminating on ontology, ethics, family, identity, and the mistakes he and his brother have made.

game.name: Fervour
game.desc: Slice, swing, shoot and dash your way to victory! Monsters have stolen souls from your land and it is up to you to get them back. As a dodgy armless creature that uses weapons as a substitute for arms, it should not be that difficult, right?

game.name: fighter_street_ii
game.desc: Un demake de Street Fighter 2.

game.name: Fishy Friends!
game.desc: Make some colourful friends in a relaxing 8-bit environment! With over one hundred million possible combinations, no fish in this game is the same!

game.name: FlipIt
game.desc: A simple puzzle game where you select blocks to flip its color. You're given a certain pattern that you need to match, and when you do, you'll progress to the next level.

game.name: Forever Lost In The Never Ending Museum Of Still Life
Forgotten Hill Pico
game.desc: Te han encomendado una extraña tarea: encontrar a Pico, una criatura que escapó del laboratorio. ¿Podrás llevar a Pico de vuelta a su jaula?

game.name: Frog King
game.desc: Una rana valiente trata de obtener la corona del rey de las ranas en un templo misterioso.

game.name: Froggy Knight : Lost in the Forest
FUZ
game.desc: This is a tiny adventure based directly on FEZ, a game by the Polytron Corporation. It is a fan work, and was not made in collaboration with or endorsed by them. FUZ features a total of 8 distinct areas. Its visuals, mechanics, and puzzles are all based off those in the original.

game.name: Galaxy Castle II Dungeons of Nimbus
Ghost House
game.desc: You find yourself outside a spooky house on Halloween night...Do you dare go in?

game.name: Gifts On Venus
game.desc: Evil skulls have put explosive gifts all over Venus! Go and slash them all to save Venus!

game.name: Golf Sunday
game.desc: Enjoy a sunny day at the golf course. Improve your putting skills and take the cart for a spin. This game was made for the LowResJam 2021 where it earned 4th place.

game.name: Got-Ya!' - A Pico-8 Gacha Game - 56 cards
Happy Bee Time
game.desc: Happy Bee Time is a randomly generated bee simulator where you try to get as many bees as you can. You explore by either buying tiles yourself for honey or letting the bees explore themselves. Once you have enough honey, you can find a tree and get even more bees!

game.name: Happy Larry and the Vampire Bat
Harold's Bad Day
game.desc: In other games, dying is bad, and your remaining lives are just chances to try again... right? No, not on Harold's Bad Day. Finish as quickly as possible, while trying to save as many Harolds as you can for a perfect run.

game.name: Hazel May Saves The Halloween Monster Soiree
Heliopause
game.desc: Heliopause: 2D space exploration and combat for the pico-8!

game.name: HIGH CLIMB ~1.1 Update~
game.desc: ¡Sube alto y cada vez más alto! ¿Qué podría haber más arriba? Nadie lo sabe... ¿Crees que puedes subir más alto que nadie?

game.name: Hug Arena
game.desc: Hug those monsters until they become your friend. You're vulnerable when you hug stuff Friends will heal you if you are close enough A level full of friends is a completed level Earn 1 of 3 perks at the end of levels 1-3-6-10-15

game.name: Hybris
game.desc: Destroy the infected cells to prevent the infection from spreading.

game.name: Hydra
game.desc: A procedurally generated hack-n-slash action adventure.

game.name: Infinite Simon - my first pico game
Jack of Spades
game.desc: Jack of Spades is a mix between card game and RPG. Control with just the mouse! Click the cards to select them and then click on the characters to set the target. Move around the map clicking on wherever you want to go. Once you get items you can equip them by clicking the icon under the character in the character selection screen.

game.name: Joya no Kane - The Rhythm Game
Justice Pizza - a platforming pizza delivery arcade memory game
Katamari Christmassy
game.desc: The King of All Cosmos was completely naughty. The stars are all gone and you, the 5cm Prince of All Cosmos, must fix this mess.

game.name: Kick Wizards
game.desc: Kick Wizards is a 1-4 player beat 'em up inspired by the old TMNT and X-Men arcade games.

game.name: Kung Fu demake
game.desc: A demake of Kung Fu for the NES. It was called "Kung Fu Master" in the arcades in the 80s.

game.name: Lands Of Yocta ~ w voxel tech write-up
game.desc: A walking simulator in a 3D Pico-8 forest.

game.name: Lektrik Sportz Game
game.desc: Lektrik Sportz Game is A Captain Neat-o Adventure by bikobird. Captain Neat-o has been shrank by Doctor Lamento and can only return to normal by running the length of a football pitch! Beat your opposition and avoid them by setting your players to engage with theirs. A tactical football game with a great 3D look.

game.name: Lemonhunter
game.desc: Go on a byte-sized adventure with Lemonhunter. Find items and gold inside the procedurally generated caves. It's up to you to decide if you want to fight the monsters, or avoid them. If you're lucky you might find the golden lemon of your dreams at the end. Only have a couple minutes left in your break? Don't worry, speedrunners will be rewarded with extra points!

game.name: Lil King
game.desc: Once there was a Lil' King. He was small in stature, but also small-minded. He believed that everyone in his kingdom was making fun of him behind his back. While this was definitely true, Lil' King had no way of knowing that. But one day, he was fed up. So he banished every last nobleman and peasant from his kingdom. Finally he could live in peace. But, a neighboring kingdom caught wind of his utter aloneness. That very knight, a siege began...

game.name: Low Mem Sky
game.desc: You awake to find yourself on an alien planet, with the desire to achieve one thing... reach the centre of the galaxy! Made in PICO-8 for #DemakeJam 2018, where the original build came 3rd Place.

game.name: Mandatory Fun Experience
game.desc: you are the REDWORM and you bring the . build places of entertainment to gather the life fluid of the solid, green places. charm the population to make them release even more life fluid! prepare a place to hold the king.

game.name: mapuzzle
game.desc: Manipulate gravity one direction at a time to get the gold and arrive at the exit.

game.name: Marballs
game.desc: Un simple clon de Marble Madness con tres niveles.

game.name: Masters of the Universe
game.desc: ¡La batalla por Eternia está en tus manos! Ponte del lado de He-Man y sus aliados o de Skeletor y sus secuaces en esta nueva versión del clásico juego de lucha con espadas bárbaros. Lucha en 8 niveles contra enemigos cada vez más difíciles o juega contra un amigo. ¡Tu tienes el poder!

game.name: Maximum Ball
game.desc: Punch the ball at the targets. Hit as many targets as you can within the time limit! The quicker you hit a target, the more points you get.

game.name: Minesweeper
game.desc: Minesweeper! Features multiple difficulty levels and amazing sound effects. Arrows transport cursor and navigate menu Z reveal tiles or activate menu options, menu opened when tiles not revealed X flag tiles for knowledge

game.name: Mini Pool
game.desc: Mini Pool is a Pico 8 pool game for two players. It features six playable characters, each with their own strengths, weaknesses and unique abilities. It's based off a modified pool rule set to make for faster paced matches.

game.name: Minima
game.desc: In Minima you take on the role of a hero trying to save the land of Miskatonia from the evil Faxon and its minions. It's up to you to explore the land, talk with the people, figure a few things out, and get strong enough to defeat the Faxon and its legions of orcs, undead, and daemons. Minima is an homage to the 8-bit Ultima games (especially Ultima II, Ultima III, Ultima IV, and Ultima V) as they were on the Commodore 128. Like those games, it features a 2D world view and 2D town views as well as 3D dungeon views.
game.genre: Juego de Rol / RPG de Acción

game.name: Monster Mix and Match Jam Gallery Cart
Moonrace
game.desc: Choose a ship. Play all 3 races of the moon tournament. After each race, you earn points for your finishing position and number of ships you destroyed. Accumulate the most points at the end of the tournament to win! In Moonrace you have no control over direction. Focus on the velocity control and manage your weapons the best you can to win the race. Player 1: X or V to Fire; Z or C to Thrust Player 2: Q or A to Fire; SHIFT or TAB to Thrust You can play with up to 8 players. The game supports controllers. You can have 2 players on the same controller with the "double control" option in the pause menu (Left/Right on the controler become Fire/Thrust). Use the Fire button to cycle between ships on the selection screen.

game.name: Mots 8-Ball Pool
game.desc: This is Mot's 8-Ball Pool, a little pool simulation inspired by 3D pool on the C64 and Amiga. Shoot a round of pool against a friend, or one of the 7 different AI characters.

game.name: Mot's Grand Prix
game.desc: Step back in time to an era when folk were real folk and racecar steering wheels were real steering wheels. Mot's Grand Prix is a pseudo 3D Formula 1 racer inspired by Grand Prix Circuit, Continental Circus and a bunch of other 80s/90s racers I've forgotten :).

game.name: MYRRHS EDGE
game.desc: You are BALTHAZAR, King of Tarse and Egypt! You are one of the Three Kings mythically following the North Star to find that baby Jesus! BUT you've woken up late -- you were supposed to be at the manger hours ago! On top of that you've forgotten your gift of Myrrh you were supposed to bring! (Maybe you can pick some up on the way?) Parkour your way across Bethlehem, avoiding aggressive Bethlehem guards, picking up 50 myrrh to fill your gift box, and get to the barn's manger as fast as you can! MYRRH'S EDGE: It's a holiday parkour speedrun challenge!

game.name: Nanoman
game.desc: Un juego hecho por fans inspirado en las versiones originales de Mega Man

game.name: Naturalchimie Classic
game.desc: It's a mix between match-3 and 2048. Three of each kind give one of the next. Will you reach gold?

game.name: Nemos Snake
game.desc: A colorful snake clone.

game.name: Night Ride
game.desc: Drive at high speed through traffic and survive the dangers you'll encounter.nnnnWill you make it through the night?

game.name: Ninjoes Trials
game.desc: In Ninjoe's Trials, you must overcome a labyrinth of rooms filled with various enemies and treasures. Use your trusty ninja discs by throwing them at your foes! Can you finish all 8 levels? Made for the 2019 Toy Box Jam. All assets (art, sounds, music) were provided at the start of the jam.

game.name: Nordic Journey to mundo del juguete
Nuklear Klone
game.desc: Suzie y Bob han sido atrapados en un mundo cruel. Puedes ayudarles a luchar para escapar?

game.name: NULL
game.desc: NULL is a surreal adventure game. What you see in the end depends on what you can find on the way. A 100% playthrough can be completed in 10-15 minutes, if you know where everything is.

game.name: Omega Enforcer X
game.desc: Fight through endless waves of aliens (+ asteroids), and become first on the leaderboard!

game.name: ORUL bend space and your mind
game.desc: Platformer about bending space and connecting it in your mind

game.name: PAT Shooter
game.desc: Simple vertical shoot'em up in space. -fire with Z -launch all missiles with X -missiles recover with time -missile deal double damage on non-shielded targets

game.name: Picotris Attack
game.desc: Swap blocks beneath the cursor. Horizontal or vertical runs of three or more matching block types are cleared. Swapping a block over an edge will cause it to fall. The stack rises over time. The game ends when blocks reach the top of the stack. The rising of the stack is delayed while matched blocks are clearing. Combos are triggered by clearing more than three blocks at once. Chains are triggered by matches caused by blocks falling due to cleared blocks below.

game.name: Pico Driller
game.desc: Welcome to Picotown, a city like any other until big blocks started to pop out of the earth right into the middle of the city! The picopeople need you: Pico Driller! Falling blocks that could squish you anytime? Small capsules of air underground? Ever-present danger? Prepare to drill your way and save the day!

game.name: Pico Frogger
game.desc: 8 modes, "easy" allows screen wrap on water, "crazy" is, well, crazy fast!

game.name: Pico Lake
game.desc: Pico Lake is a pocket-sized walk & click adventure game

game.name: Pico Monsters
game.desc: Pico Monsteres is a Pokemon-esque jrpg. In this game there are markers called 'picostops' scattered throughout the map which drop random items whenever you have defeated a few wild monsters. 'Picostops' also replenish and revive all the monsters in your party. Catch new monsters with picoballs. Due to the save restrictions of pico8 the team size in this is only 4. Every wild monsters can have up to 4 different moves it's recommended to catch and compare to build your best team. There is also a very small story about professor corks whereabouts... Each monster is associated with an element and some elements have advantages over others. Advantage of elements: Earth: none Air: Water Water: Fire Fire: Earth, Air Controls: arrow keys: move around x: open menu to view monsters, items and save z: interact with people and things

game.name: Pico Night Punkin' - FNF Demake
game.desc: This is a low-res demake of Friday Night Funkin' made in PICO-8 for Pico Day 2021.

game.name: Offroad
game.desc: Pico Off Road is a racing game inspired by the classic Ironman Super Off Road. There are 5 car colors to choose from (equal by parameters), three tracks that can be played in both directions. Player can choose from two modes - single race or tournament. There is one "hidden" mode: single race with 0 opponents can be considered as a practice.

game.name: Pico Pirates!
game.desc: Pico Pirates is an open world adventure game featuring deadly monsters, rival pirates and beautiful sandy beaches! You set out on your quest to find The Pirate King and claim the crown for yourself. To do this, you'll need to find the 4 compass pieces scattered around the vast, procedurally generated world and keep your crews spirits high throughout (pirates lovely treasure and a good fight!).

game.name: Pico Racer
game.desc: Pole Position/Enduro/OutRun derivative. Features: Day and night Three landscapes Obstacles and jumps A strict time limit See how well you did in the course map overview Really messy source code Terrible sound

game.name: pico Skate IV - a tiny skateboard game
Pico Snail! Dream Castle
game.desc: You play as Snail-Chan, and are tasked with defending the Dream Castle! You can run, jump, thwack enemies, and use stars you collect for special powers! Inspired by the musician Snail's House.

game.name: Pico Tanks
game.desc: A Battle City clone.

game.name: Pico Tennis
game.desc: Play against AI or with up to 4 players. Z to hit the ball. To hit the ball in different directions you need to hit it when it's off to your side. So the further to your right the ball is when you hit it the more it will go left. X to do a power shot. Whenever you return the ball during a rally you will build up power. You can do a power shot anytime you have power in your meter, but the more it builds up the faster your shot will be.

game.name: Pico Tetris
game.desc: Why are you reading this? It's Tetris, you probably already know how it works.

game.name: Pico World Race
game.desc: Get in your supercar and take a trip around the world, testing your driving skills on challenging circuits against a host of opponents.

game.name: Pico Zombie Garden: A PvZ Demake
game.desc: A demake of the first world of the original Plants vs. Zombies. 10 levels, 8 different plants, 5 different zombies, 3 complete songs!

game.name: picogolf
game.desc: picogolf (currently) contains a single 9 hole course featuring a range of par 3, 4 and 5 holes. There are no settings, nothing gets saved, if you wanna play again, just reload the page. It actually started out as a simple breakout clone... I'm not really sure what happened but here we are, I've had a great time working on it and I'm quite pleased with myself for actually finishing something for once.

game.name: PICOHOT
game.desc: Hello! We present to you PICOHOT, an 8-bit homage to the original SUPERHOT game created by three members of the SUPERHOT Team. The whole idea had been conceived out of a marketing concept of fitting a whole game on a floppy disk. Then, someone had superb thought to use PICO-8 for that. Retro feel and ease of use that came with this tool took us right away while technological constraints made it an intriguing design challenge. Thanks to the PICO-8 community and zep for creating such an amazing tool. You guys made working on PICOHOT a blast!

game.name: Picokaiju
game.desc: You are one big monster with a thirst for destruction. This quick turn-based roguelike PICO-8 game is all about stomping, smashing, grabbing, and chomping your way through a procedurally generated hapless city and its tiny citizens.

game.name: PicoKart
game.desc: Compete in a 3D, high-speed go-cart race against computer-controlled mouse opponents in three challenging tracks.

game.name: PICOPICO GRANDPRIX 0.1
game.desc: Retro racing game for pico-8 with drifting. Only time attack is available in the 0.1 version.

game.name: PICOWARE
game.desc: Do you love WarioWare? And do you love PICO-8? What we if we combine them into one game that you can play in your browser, right now? Say hello to PICOWARE! Over 50+ developers made 68 microgames during the 24 hour PICOWARE gamejam starting on July 27th 2019, with the intention of combining them together into one bigger game, called PICOWARE!

game.name: PicoWars - Advance Wars Demake
game.desc: Picowars is an 8bit homage to one of the greatest Nintendo games of all time: Advance Wars. It is a turn-based strategy game where the objective is to build up an army from your bases in order to capture more properties on the map and eventually capture the opposing player's headquarters.

game.name: pinballvania!

game.name: Ramps

As well as racing you'll need to navigate jumps, roller-coaster like ramps and occasionally even drive upside down. Includes 3 difficulty levels, plus a practice mode for getting the feel of the tracks.

Keep your torch lit via passing flames and reaching checkpoints as you descend deeper. Avoid spikes, watch out for dowsing waterfalls, master difficult platforming and discover the ancient secret within!

game.name: Solid Rogue
game.desc: This is Solid Rogue, a "coffeebreak" roguelike where you play as Badger, a stealth operative who has just stolen plans for the bipedal nuclear weapon known as Rogue Gear! Help Badger climb 20 stories of a bad-guy infested facility to freedom!

game.name: Super Disc Box
game.desc: Are you ready to get sliced in half? The year is 2089 and Vlambeer's SUPER CRATE BOX is coming to bring back the glory of the golden arcade age, when all that really mattered was getting on that high score list and a giant disc has appeared in orbit of Jupiter. Step into the oversized space suit of a brave scientist and grab your baseball cap and loosen your pants, it's time to explore this sprawling intergalactic slaughterhouse and fight endless hordes of enemies and collect every weapon crate you can.

game.name: S W O R D F I S H
game.desc: An aquatic action game. Swim sword first into the deep to destroy the evil at the heart of the ocean. Featuring: - fast, dynamic old school gameplay inspired by Ecco the Dolphin - Multiple enemy types each with their own attack patterns and weaknesses - 25 levels of aquatic action - A plucky swordfish with a charge attack and nothing to lose.

The Green Legion
game.desc: Blast off and strike the evil green legion of mutating ships from outer-space!

game.name: The Lair: now at a silky smooth 60 fps!
game.desc: There is a Dark Lord terrorizing the northern coast since generations. What was once a thriving land full of bustling ports and cities has now gone to ruin, and the people of the Moonlit Empire are frankly fed up with all that. You drew the shortest straw at the Order of Night's Vigil, so taking care of the situation is now your task. Punch through to the evil overlord's inner sanctum in Shearwater Keep and defeat him!

game.name: The Lich King
game.desc: All over the kingdom the Lich King is feared His power and evil is total Many have tried to destroy him Many have failed Will you?

game.name: The Remains of El Dorado
game.desc: The Remains of El Dorado es un juego roguelike para PICO-8. Estás buscando el Amuleto del Sol, que te traerá gran fama y fortuna... si sobrevives. Remains es por turnos. Cuando estés en una situación difícil, no olvides reducir la velocidad y pensar en todas tus opciones. ¡No mueras con una poción en el bolsillo! Explora la ciudad perdida. Encuentra el amuleto.

game.name: The Story of Zeldo

game.name: The Tower of Archeos
game.desc: Climb the tower of archeos and kill the evil sorcerer Attack group of same kind of monsters monsters will retaliate but group size dont affect final damage, so try to destroy large groups first. when your xp need reach 0 you gain a new heart and refill your life + items Blocked door and chests can be opened by killing monsters next to it Open a door to climb one floor Reach the 9th floor to fight Archeos

game.name: They Started It
game.desc: We lived in peace for thousands of years, until they came. Aggressive beyond reason and sporting a dubious dress sense, they attacked in droves; we pushed them back, but they kept coming. Eventually they were down to their last ship. Still it comes at us, attempting to exterminate us for unknown reasons. Seemingly unable to take a hint. You are that ship. Leave your morals at the door and destroy those poor aliens for no logical reason.

game.name: Thopter Escape
game.desc: A game about flying a damaged ornithopter through a sand storm on Arrakis. 3 levels of windy action! Fake speech synthesis!

game.name: The Return of Timmy: The Grappling Hook

game.desc: ¡Hazte a un lado Jack Nicklaus! Tom Brinton te invita a que te unas a él para jugar golf.

game.name: Tiny Parkour
game.desc: Tiny Parkour is a micro-parkour game for Pico-8. Each of its long levels are filled with tiny platforms, stairways, and different routes to get to the end. The title screen is a parkour course to get you used to playing the game, although it is not as long as the normal courses. To keep you going the right way, there are animated markers which you can follow as well as collect. Sometimes these serve as checkpoints for very challenging points in the game, while often they are just there to give you some direction. You can play Tiny Parkour zoomed out, seeing the entirety of the level, or zoomed in on your character and the direct areas around you. This helps for more precision jumping. To succeed, players will need to take their time to plot out where they are going. This tiny parkour course is no joke.

game.name: To a Starling
game.desc: Use your teleportation abilities to whirl through the rocky wastes in a world that hides its brightest stars deep underground.

game.name: Tower Noire
game.desc: Tower Noire is a 7DRL roguelike inspired by Cave Noire, Little Nemo, and Powder.

game.name: Trials of the Sorcerer
game.desc: Trial of the Sorcerer is a procedurally generated 3D first person shooter inspired by Wolfenstein 3D and Catacomb Abyss. Shoot monsters, collect loot, find keys to unlock doors, and try to find the exit to the next level. And don't forget to pickup the power crystals to level-up your magic staff along the way.

game.name: Tube Runner
game.desc: Fly through the tunnel as fast as possible avoiding the walls. The tunnel is divided in to Zones, with four Quadrants per zone. Each zone is progressively longer and more difficult than the previous, with sharper turns, more turns, and narrower sections.

game.name: Twin Strike - endless vertical shmup action
game.desc: Twin Strike is a vertical shmup in which you, as the pilot of either a helicopter or a jet, must destroy alien ships and defend Earth! There is no end, it just gets harder with each loop. There are three distinct backgrounds and two possible pieces of background music, so the scenery and music shuffle with each round. Scoring and missiles Every time you kill an enemy, you fill your missile meter by one. Every three points nets you a powerful missile you can launch with the z key. If you fill all twelve points, you get a score 2x multiplier that lasts until you launch a missile. If you launch when you have all 12 points, you get a smart bomb explosion that eliminates all bullets and hurts everything on the screen, but you also spend nine points instead of three.

game.name: U-turn
game.desc: The goal is to take the red flag to the opposite side of the island. If you succeed, another flag will appear on the opposite side, and so on. Your time is refreshed each time you take a flag. If you capture 2 / 5 / 10 / 15 flags you will unlock permanent skills. If you reset the cart your skills and hi-score will be reset too.

game.name: UFO Swamp Odyssey
game.desc: A short atmospheric platformer with metroidvania elements. Your UFO has been knocked out of the sky by scavengers and you're now trapped in their swampy junk yard. With the help of some friendly aliens, find a way to disable the electromagnetic pulse cannon that's keeping you from escaping.

game.name: underworld siege

game.genre: Juego de Rol / RPG de Mazmorras

game.desc: The only thing you can do is jump - is that enough to climb a mountain?

game.name: VALLEYRUN
game.desc: Cover as much distance as you can in as low a time as you can. Collect additional fuel to keep your ship running longer. Dodge the obstacles.

game.name: Villager
game.desc: Welcome, Villager! You are on this island to build a cosy little town for the peeple that want to live here. Gather wood and stones to build and unlock other buildings. Some produce resources for you, others make your inhabitants happy. Well-fed and happy peeple produce more resources, but keep them hungry or sad and they will leave. They might seem a bit lazy, but without them, buildings won't produce anything! Build your first house and somebody will come soon, but there is no rush! Take your time and explore the island. There is no pressing matter, no harsh lose-condition, so be creative and build something beautiful. Be good to them, and have fun.

game.name: Virtuous Vanquisher of Evil
game.desc: Loot and slash your way through this fantasy roguelike action RPG. There are 9 item classes (Swords, Bows, Boots,etc) and item prefixes (Heavy, Sharp, Ice, etc.) and and 5 item suffixes (of Haste, of Icebolt, of Concentration,etc). There are active skills and passive skills. Active skills you have to assign to a button to use. Passive skills happens automatically, without your input. There are 4 different areas with distinct enemies and unique parameters for the randomised dungeon layout.
game.genre: Juego de Rol / RPG de Acción

game.name: We Missed You!
game.desc: Es un día normal de trabajo en el servicio postal. ¿Qué mejor momento para salir a hacer entregas cuando todo el mundo está trabajando? Con más de 10 emocionantes entregas y unos cuantos desvíos por una enorme ciudad, no se sabe lo que vivirás siendo el peor monstruo que la humanidad puede ofrecer. Asegúrate de conducir de la forma más temeraria posible, ¡de lo contrario las carreteras se volverán tan seguras que la gente entregará sus paquetes ella misma!

game.name: willo
game.desc: Skelliwags have taken over the graveyard and its up to Willo to kick them out! Help little Willo sneak around, go 'woo', blow out candles and get up to all sorts of spooky stealthy fun in this short stealth'n'spook-em-up.
